limitations: Build and refresh have one observation per process (two per source/size), not a latency percentile.
No retained-heap improvement: estimator excludes per-query temporaries, allocator overhead and process RSS.
Mixed 100k common-term p95 and adverse candidate build/refresh observations retained without a universal speedup claim.
No format, source replay, authority, dependency, API-signature or admission-limit change.
Binding remains a caller assertion; this cached projection is not a remote freshness or authorization proof.
